resources.string: Allow separate mod folders and editable settings outside Android/data.
Allow file access on the next Android screen, then return to OpenMW. This lets OpenMW read mod folders and write your settings in shared storage. Root is not required.
Allowed. Shared mod and configuration folders can be used.

Use %1$s, or choose another folder. Existing configuration is copied without deleting the originals. Files already in the selected folder are kept. The folder is read and written when the game starts.

Choose the folder containing a mod’s meshes, textures or plugin files. The base Data Files folder stays untouched. Enable plugins in the Plugins tab. In Directories, drag folders into order; lower folders override earlier folders. Long-press a folder to remove it from the list.
Folder removed from the launcher. Files on storage were not deleted.
